ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels comprise approximately 85% of the visible surface area; high-intensity (white/grey) pixels are localized in mottled patterns on distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 92 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude irregular serrations and jagged tearing on the left distal tip. Moderate-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys across the right lobe's trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-convex trajectory on the distal margins transitioning to a sharp concavity at the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct diagonal dark linear pixel disruptions crossing the left lobe; one prominent vertical dark linear mark on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular loss of fluke tissue at the left tip (tearing); multiple irregular notches on the right trailing edge consistent with physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique vertical dark streak on the lower-right fluke lobe that breaks the horizontal mottling flow.
